shortDescription: CBAK Energy NASDAQ:CBAT rises 8.5% in Wednesday's trading to its highest in more than two years after saying it signed an investment agreement with the Nanjing Gaochun Economic Development Zone for the research, development, and manufacture of large cylindrical sodium-ion battery cells and integrat…

children: rises 8.5% in Wednesday's trading to its highest in more than two years after saying it
an investment agreement with the Nanjing Gaochun Economic Development Zone for the research, development, and manufacture of large cylindrical sodium-ion battery cells and integrated battery systems.
The project would add 12 GWh of annual cell production capacity, the company said, advancing its previously announced sodium-ion expansion plan.
At current lithium-ion cell market prices, the company estimated the 12 GWh project could generate an additional RMB4.8B-RMB5B ($712M-$741M) in annual revenue at full capacity with all output sold.
also said it is targeting an additional 6 GWh of annual cell capacity from 4.5 GWh currently at its existing Nanjing facility by year-end 2026.
At full capacity with all production sold, the additional 6 GWh could generate an estimated RMB2.4B-RMB2.7B ($356M-$400M) in annual revenue, the company said.

title: CBAK Energy jumps on sodium-ion battery expansion plans in Nanjing
